info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Trade Banking By Factoring Id-spec
info.description: The Trade Banking Retrieval API facilitates the access and retrieval of trade banking information associated with a specific factoring ID. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions seeking to integrate trade finance solutions into their operations. Users, such as risk analysts and trade finance managers, can utilize this API to obtain detailed data regarding trade banking activities linked to particular transactions. By implementing this API, organizations can enhance their decision-making processes and improve the efficiency of their banking operations.

get.summary: Retrieve factoring details for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific factoring resource identified by its unique ID. It provides all the necessary details to understand the status and attributes of the requested factoring item.

requestBody.description: Request body for the RES-100045 operation in the factoring service. This operation retrieves information related to specific trade banking factoring requests based on the criteria defined in the schema.
